# v0.1.0

First release.

- Save a Finder view as a preset, from a folder you already arranged or in the editor with a live preview.
- Apply presets to chosen folders, with or without subfolders, or to Finder's default view and your home folder.
- Apply the starred preset to the front Finder window with a keyboard shortcut; a step-by-step guide shows how to set it.
- Every change is backed up first and can be undone from History.
- The app restarts Finder when needed and reopens your Finder windows.
- English and Korean.
